title: EffectEvent
description: The payload of every effect transition event (docs/design/m0/03 "External effects"): effect.intent/v1, effect.observed/v1, effect.failed/v1, effect.uncertain/v1, effect.retried/v1 and effect.reconciled/v1. The event's subject is the effect id. The state machine: an intent makes the effect pending; from pending, observed makes it completed, failed (before send proven) failed_confirmed, uncertain uncertain; from uncertain, reconciled makes it completed, failed_confirmed or (still_uncertain) leaves it uncertain, and retried (only for a kind idempotent at its target) makes it pending again. internal/eventstore enforces it.

kind.description: The effect kind; set on intent, null otherwise.

target.description: What the effect acts on (a provider, a remote ref, a deploy target); set on intent, null otherwise.

request_digest.description: Digest of the canonical request; set on intent, null otherwise.

outcome.description: The reconciliation outcome; set on reconciled, null otherwise.

observation.description: What was observed (empty on intent and retry).

result_ref.description: A blob holding the effect's result, when there is one.
